references.text: The breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution offering were given to Aaron and his sons as their share, establishing the principle that priests receive these parts of the sacrifice.
Instructions regarding the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh belonging to the priests. This is the foundational legislation referred to in Num 18:18.
Moses confirms that the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution offering belong to Aaron and his sons as a permanent right.
The priests' rights to specific parts of the sacrificial animals are confirmed, including the shoulder, cheeks, and stomach.
The holy wave-offering breast and the lifted thigh that were waved and lifted up belong to Aaron and his sons.
